proof_scope: Local deterministic validation of strict Pydantic JSONL explainers, question routing, sample generation, and fail-closed malformed fields. Does not launch VS Code, Live Evidence, Excalidraw, or debugger sessions.

cases.name: sample-jsonl-validates
command:
cd .. && ./run.sh validate fixtures/sample.explainers.jsonl | tee /tmp/explain-project-validate.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/explain-project-validate.json'))
assert d['status']=='PASS' and d['records']==1 and d['features']==['publish.report_last']
print('EXPLAIN_PROJECT_VALIDATE_OK')
PY

cases.name: question-routes-to-debugger-and-diagram-bindings
command:
cd .. && ./run.sh ask fixtures/sample.explainers.jsonl --question 'A worker crashes before success; what prevents incomplete release?' | tee /tmp/explain-project-route.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/explain-project-route.json'))
assert d['matched_feature']=='publish.report_last'
assert d['diagram']['source_kind']=='excalidraw' and d['debugger_stops'][0]['locals']==['tmp','report_path','output_corpus']
print('EXPLAIN_PROJECT_ROUTE_OK')
PY

cases.name: extra-field-refused
command:
cd .. && T=$(mktemp -d) && cp fixtures/sample.explainers.jsonl $T/bad.jsonl && python3 - <<'PY' $T/bad.jsonl
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]
d=json.loads(open(p).readline()); d['surprise']='nope'; open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d)+'\n')
PY
if ./run.sh validate $T/bad.jsonl >$T/out 2>$T/err; then exit 1; fi; grep -q extra_forbidden $T/out && echo EXPLAIN_PROJECT_EXTRA_REFUSED

cases.name: sample-command-emits-valid-jsonl
command: cd .. && T=$(mktemp -d) && ./run.sh sample --output $T/explainers.jsonl && ./run.sh validate $T/explainers.jsonl | grep -q '"status": "PASS"' && echo EXPLAIN_PROJECT_SAMPLE_OK
